title: Update react-dev-utils to version 0.4.1 🚀
body:

0.4.1 (September 3, 2016)

Build Dependency (react-scripts)

  • We now support (but don’t recommend) .jsx file extension. (@tizmagik in #563)
  • Proxy request errors are now printed to the console. (@cloudmu in #502)

Migrating from 0.4.0 to 0.4.1

Inside any created project that has not been ejected, run:

npm install --save-dev --save-exact react-scripts@0.4.1
